text_block_list.text:
While out on a walk with Meisho Doto, we passed by
the shopping district. Just then—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? There's kind of a crowd gathering...
S-Should we... make a run for it for now?

There's no need to suddenly run away.
Wondering what was going on, you took a peek...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up! Come try the fun, exciting lottery draw!
Hey there, Umamusume hiding behind their back, won't you give it a spin?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The raffle... Just imagining what I might win
makes me... ah, awawawa...
It's not like anything bad will come out. We only had one raffle ticket, so we decided to draw it together.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: So this is... the raffle wheel... I need to make sure I don't grip it too hard and snap it in two...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Don't break, don't break... Argh, to hell with it!

Reciting some mysterious wish,
I gently turned the crank on the lottery wheel!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eeeeehhhhhhk?!
He was clearly—knocked out cold.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: No waaaay, I couldn't possibly accept thissss.
choice_data_list: Why not go to a hot spring?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
No way, no way, absolutely no wayyy!
I have my hands full just with races right now, and besides...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm always messing up and bad things keep happening to me... so I don't even know how to process feeling this happy...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Besides, there's a reason why I absolutely cannot go on an onsen trip.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to lose the tickets!
If I keep holding them, I definitely will. Before the day is out!

...Indeed. I doubt Meisho Doto
can keep from losing her ticket
until the race wraps up.
choice_data_list: Then shall I hold onto it for you?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, Trainer is... doing it?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, then it definitely won't get lost.
You're not like me, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Then, um... please do.
Or rather..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "If you want to use it, please go ahead. A hot spring is far too luxurious for someone like me."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I was just happy to have won anything at all...

"Even if you say that, I can't possibly use it.
Let's save this as a reward for the future Meisho Doto."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"A-A s-special grade carrot...!?
I-I won something incredible~!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I, I~~!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Phewwww...
I'm so full already~...
choice_data_list: Even though I haven't eaten yet!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-It's kinda like... just winning is enough to make me feel satisfied, or happy, or something~

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, doing a lottery with someone
is really something else, isn't it? When I was alone,
I didn't really have good memories of it.

It seems Meisho Doto isn't really the type
who's blessed with good luck in raffles.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um... Is it okay if I eat this hamburger steak once I get home?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*yawn* On top of all this, if I get to eat delicious food too,
I'll just be way too happy.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness... I'm so glad I got to
go out with Trainer-san today♪"
After that, we split some delicious Salisbury steak and shared a warm, heartwarming time.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, Trainer-san, there are carrots,
so, so, so many of theeeem♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"With this much, we'll be totally fine!
What a relief."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fweh? Um, there isn't really
anything in particular, but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If we have plenty, then even if we mess up once,
we can just try again, right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I'm doing anything special
with the carrots, but...

Safety in numbers, no matter what.
Meisho Doto seems to feel
that kind of reassurance.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. But since we're already here,
maybe I'll try something I'm usually too scared to do.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Like peeling vegetables, or making a finely chopped salad♪
Afterward, Meisho Doto and I enjoyed carrots cooked in all sorts of different ways.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
One stick... Uuu, I'm so sorry, Trainer.
It's all my fault~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If only I were a little less clumsy,
and had better luck with these kinds of things...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I bet I would've gotten two winning sticks~!

Meisho Doto harbored a dream that wasn't
much different. However...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Little lady, there's no prize where you get two of 'em, ya know?
Second prize, the one above this, is a whole bunch of carrots, though.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh, so many~!?
Is that true~?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Then as I am right now, it's completely impossible. Uuu, I'll go back to the drawing board~.
Afterward, Meisho Doto and I walked home together, happily munching on carrots.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Tissues...
A dud... a consolation prize...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... It's a shame, but
I feel a little relieved too..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Deep down, I guess I've always thought,
"I guess this is just all I'm capable of."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Thinking of it as just business as usual
made me feel a little relieved...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Still, but even so, I can't keep acting like this. Things are different from before my debut, after all.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I have to let myself feel this frustration. Next time...
Next time, for sure...!

"True, getting used to feeling at rock bottom isn't
a good thing. Let's embrace this frustration and face it."
